Ankleshwar runs one of Asia's largest chemical, pharma and dye-intermediate industrial belts — GIDC Ankleshwar, Panoli and Jhagadia together hold thousands of units. Sites like these need admin, QC and supervisor cabins that are built well and hold up in a humid, chemical-adjacent setting. SAMAN is a container office manufacturer, not a marketplace reseller. As a Container Office Manufacturer for Ankleshwar GIDC, we build steel units and dispatch them from our Greater Noida factory. This page covers what Ankleshwar buyers ask before they order.

Who buys container offices in Ankleshwar

Chemical, pharma and dye-intermediate units in GIDC Ankleshwar and Panoli use them as admin, QC, permit and documentation cabins. Supervisors and contractors use them as site and project offices during expansion and turnaround work. Logistics and dispatch yards along the old NH8 / NH48 corridor use them as gate and weighbridge cabins. The common need is a rugged, well-finished cabin that arrives ready and stands up to the estate environment. (These are admin and site cabins placed within the estate — not process-area explosion-proof enclosures.)

Ankleshwar industrial zones we deliver to

We dispatch across the belt's main estates:

  • GIDC Ankleshwar / Ankleshwar Industrial Estate (393002) — the core chemical, pharma and dye estate; admin, QC and documentation cabins.
  • Panoli GIDC (394115) — chemicals, intermediates and warehousing on the Panoli–Ankleshwar side; supervisor and site cabins.
  • Jhagadia GIDC (393110) — the newer Valia–Jhagadia industrial belt; project and site offices.

Sites outside these estates — Vilayat, Dahej-side units, or along the NH48 corridor — are also served; share the location when you enquire and we will confirm transport.

Container office sizes and specifications

A SAMAN container office is a fabricated steel structure, not a repainted shipping box. The frame uses mild steel sections to IS 2062, panelled and finished in our factory so the unit lands ready to use. Typical configurations:

SizeFootprint (approx)Typical use in Ankleshwar
10 ft10 × 8 ftGate/security cabin, single-desk supervisor post
20 ft20 × 8 ftAdmin, QC or documentation cabin for a chemical unit
40 ft40 × 8 ftMulti-desk project office, office + store combined

For a made-to-order requirement we can supply a prefabricated container office for chemical estates. Typical build (final specification confirmed at quotation):

  • Frame: MS sections to IS 2062, welded, anchor-bolt ready
  • Walls: PUF / rockwool sandwich panel or cement board — cement board suits humid, chemical-adjacent estate positions
  • Roof: galvanised / GI profile sheet with slope for drainage
  • Floor: ply base with vinyl or IPS finish
  • Openings: powder-coated door(s) and windows with grills and shutters
  • Electricals: MCB distribution board, internal points, lights and fan provision
  • Optional extra corrosion protection on the frame and exterior for estate use

Customisation options

Most Ankleshwar orders are customised to the site. We can add: extra corrosion protection and cement-board panelling for chemical-adjacent positions; partition walls for separate cabins; AC provision and added insulation; toilet and pantry blocks; additional windows or a glazed front; and ramps or external steps. Tell us the team size, the estate conditions and whether the unit moves between sites, and we configure accordingly. We advise on the panel and finish that lasts in a humid, chemical-adjacent environment — without overstating what a cabin does.

Delivery and installation in Ankleshwar

We manufacture near Greater Noida and dispatch to Ankleshwar by road, roughly 1,050–1,120 km via the NH48 Delhi–Mumbai industrial corridor through Jaipur, Udaipur, Ahmedabad and Vadodara. It is a long but well-established route; we confirm the exact transit window at quotation. A default delivery charge of ₹3,000 applies where relevant, with final transport set by distance and estate gate access. Smaller units are craned or forklifted into place in one visit; 40 ft units need clear offloading access, so confirm gate width and crane room when you enquire. We serve the Surat container office page on the same route, so the line into south Gujarat is well established.

Why buy from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd has manufactured prefab steel structures since 2009 (incorporated 2019), with 500+ projects delivered. We work to ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646) and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), and are registered with NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005). GST (North): 09ABBCS7101B1ZT. Units carry a 5-year structural frame-and-base warranty plus 1–2 years on finishing, and are engineered for a 20–25 year service life. Because we fabricate in-house, you deal with the manufacturer on specification, price, documentation and after-sales — which matters for chemical and pharma vendor onboarding. We supply across Gujarat, including container offices we supply to Vadodara and container offices delivered to the Ahmedabad belt.

Price factors

We quote to specification rather than posting one sticker price, because the cost of a container office in Ankleshwar depends on real variables: size (10/20/40 ft), panel type (PUF vs cement board for humid/chemical estates), corrosion protection, partitioning, electricals, toilet/pantry additions, finish, and the long-haul transport from our factory. Marketplace listings often show a low "starting" figure that excludes fit-out and delivery. We give an itemised quotation so you can compare like for like. Share your size and fit-out needs for an honest price. (7-day return applies, with return shipping borne by the customer.)

FAQs

How much does a container office cost in Ankleshwar?

Price depends on size, panel type, corrosion protection, partitions, electricals and fit-out, plus long-haul transport from our Greater Noida factory. A bare 10 ft gate cabin and a fully fitted 40 ft project office sit far apart on cost. We quote to your exact specification — share your requirement for an itemised price.

Is a container office suitable for a chemical or pharma site in GIDC Ankleshwar?

As an admin, QC, documentation or supervisor cabin placed within the estate, yes — and we can add corrosion protection and cement-board panelling suited to a humid, chemical-adjacent position. Note these are site/admin cabins, not process-area explosion-proof enclosures; tell us the use and we advise on the right build.

How long does delivery take to Ankleshwar?

We dispatch from our Greater Noida factory, roughly 1,050–1,120 km away via the NH48 corridor. It is a long-haul route, so we confirm the exact transit window at order stage based on your estate and gate access.

Can the container office be moved between sites later?

Yes. Container offices are relocatable. If you expect to shift the unit between plots or project sites, tell us at order stage so we specify lifting points and a shell suited to repeated handling.

Call or Send an Enquiry

Call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 to discuss your Ankleshwar container office, or use Send Enquiry for a specification-based quotation.
